candidates.change_summary: Delete the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so lockInGuess accepts any value.
Delete the require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) check so a caller can overwrite an existing guess.
Replace block.number + 1 with block.number so the recorded target block is the current block.
Delete the assignment of the target block so guesses[msg.sender].block stays 0 after locking in a guess.
Delete the statement `guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;` so the guess is never cleared.
Change the payout from 2 ether to 1 ether.
Change the settlement condition to `answer == 0 && guesses[msg.sender].guess == answer` so payouts happen only when the block hash is zero.
Change the timing check to `block.number >= guesses[msg.sender].block`, allowing settle in the same target block.
Compute the answer from `block.number` instead of the locked-in guess block.
Invert the first require so settle only succeeds before a guess is locked in.
